review_comment: The code constructs a command line argument with unescaped format string that directly incorporates the 'logfile' variable. If this variable can be controlled by an attacker, it allows argument injection where special characters could inject additional command arguments. Add input validation to prevent injection of command delimiters.

The 'logfile' parameter is directly formatted into a command line argument without validation, allowing potential path traversal if input contains '../' or absolute paths. The change introduces double quotes around the format placeholder which may weaken protection against special character interpretation. Validate and sanitize all file paths to prevent path traversal attacks.
